writer_block:
NUMBERS (state only these, with their listed meaning; dated snapshots up to a listed live count are fine):
- Standard stamp duty is nothing on the first £125,000 of the price
- 2% is charged on the portion from £125,001 to £250,000
- 5% is charged on the portion from £250,001 to £925,000
- 10% is charged on the portion from £925,001 to £1.5 million
- 12% is charged on the portion above £1.5 million
- First-time buyers pay no stamp duty up to £300,000
- First-time buyers pay 5% on the portion from £300,001 to £500,000
- Above £500,000 first-time buyer relief disappears entirely — the standard bands apply to the whole price
- An additional residential property usually costs 5 percentage points on top of each stamp duty band
- The additional-property surcharge applies to purchases of £40,000 or more
